description: Implementation of ReadBufferingStreamSocket class handling buffered reading over a socket in the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: ReadBufferingStreamSocket
classes.description: A socket class that provides buffered reading capabilities, wrapping an underlying StreamSocket.

methods.name: BufferNextRead
methods.description: Prepares the buffer for the next read operation with specified size.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Attempts to read data if the socket is ready.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Handles the state machine for read operations.

methods.name: DoRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the underlying socket.

methods.name: DoReadComplete
methods.description: Completes a read operation, updating buffer state.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a read operation completes.

methods.name: CopyToCaller
methods.description: Copies data from internal buffer to user buffer.
